description: Client-side optimization mod for Minecraft 1.8.9 (Ornithe/Fabric) that culls off-screen, occluded, and distant animated texture updates to reduce CPU and GPU upload overhead.

mods.name: TexCull
mods.description: Client-side animated-texture culling optimizations for Minecraft 1.8.9.

releases.notes:
## TexCull v1.1.0 (Minecraft 1.8.9 — Ornithe / Fabric)

### Highlights
- **Frustum & Occlusion-Aware Distance Culling** via Argentum / Celeritas (GenericSectionSpriteTicker)
- **Identity-backed Sprite Set + MethodHandles** for fast O(1) sprite lookups and minimal section-scan overhead
- **Held Item & Item Sprite Exemption** (items/*, clock, compass, and the currently held main-hand block/item)
- **Argentum Video Settings Tab** (Master toggle, Max Animation Distance 1–16 / Unlimited, and Show F3 Debug Info toggle)
- **Richer F3 Debug HUD** (TexCull: culled/total (%) | Dist + nearby sprite & section counts)
- **Zero-Overhead When Disabled** (all chunk-meshing and sprite-tracking hooks short-circuit immediately)
